subject: science
concept: Understanding how human activity can affect an ecosystem, both positively and negatively
source_inspiration: adapted from NGSS Earth and Human Activity Disciplinary Core Ideas — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student sorts human-activity example cards into 'helps ecosystem' and 'harms ecosystem' piles
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a human action to its likely effect on a pictured ecosystem
exercise.abstract: Student explains one way people can help protect a given ecosystem

misconception_flags: assumes human activity always harms ecosystems, missing legitimate positive examples like conservation

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
